One end of the plate is fixed and the other is free. When the player presses the free end with a finger or a fingernail and then lets the finger slip off, the released reed vibrates. An instrument may have only one tongue (as the Jew's harp does) or several (as the mbira thumb piano does).

Its crisp attack is akin to that of folk instruments such as the yangqin, but plainer and more rustic.

該樂器與著名的姆比拉拇指琴有相似之處，但在結構和音域上各具特色。在非洲傳統社區中: The instrument resembles the well-known mbira thumb piano, but has its own character in structure and range. In traditional African communities the Oopoochawa has long been used for religious ritual, social gatherings and popular entertainment, and carries a deep cultural content. With globalisation the instrument has gradually reached other parts of the world and drawn the interest of musicians and instrument lovers. The contemporary world-music movement has pushed its spread further, making it a bridge for cross-cultural music exchange and giving it an important place in ethnomusicological research and practice.
